name: Hindi (Devanagari)
notes: Devanagari has no upper case: NEVER use a caps style, use weight 700-800 instead.
Matras sit above the line: line_height must be >= 1.05 or the top matra clips.
Conjuncts make words wider: budget 1.18x the English character count per line.
Do not transliterate the script into Roman inside captions. Captions follow the audio script.
Whisper small.en will silently produce garbage on Hindi. Model must be large-v3 or a hi-finetune.
